rules.universe: The approved static pilot universe is unchanged across ten sessions and each session binds its manifest at 07:45.
rules.late: Any ready_for_use_at later than 08:40:00 is late, including the interval through 08:45:00, and cannot replace an on-time snapshot or alter the frozen cohort.
rules.entry: The intended entry is the session official regular open; the contract five-session exit is unchanged.
rules.delay: Delayed execution cannot move a deadline or backdate readiness.
